limitations: New approval is limited to the inspected ecoinvent 3.9 cut-off metalworking service identity. Positive source and native references are one kg of processing service per kg of final manufactured product, factor +1. This is processing, not supply of one kg bulk metal. Preserve signed caller service kg, supported uncertainty/formulas, foreground ownership and separately listed materials, emissions and degreasing. Other releases, patches, system models and reverse routes receive no new approval.

Use the complete same-metal native average metalworking process once. Both source and native include nominal machine/factory operation and processing-loss metal, while excluding the main semi-finished metal input and degreasing. Keep caller-supplied bulk metal separate. Do not remove the internal loss allowance, add another full kg of metal, multiply service demand by gross-to-net yield, normalize loss-metal fractions, infer a scrap credit or automatically add degreasing. Nominal metal-class loss amounts, machine demand and factory construction quantities match; this does not establish full upstream LCI or stochastic equivalence.

The native complete service replaces source internal manufacturing, utilities/heat, infrastructure, metal-production supply and delivery, waste handling, allocation, vintage and internal uncertainty. Native factory/machine operations remain inside that service; do not duplicate them externally. Native material-grade/form, production-market boundary and energy geography can differ even where named interface quantities match. The original source loss-material grades and distribution portfolios are not reconstructed. These are explicit screening proxies; native/source LCI, LCIA and stochastic equivalence are not claimed and score effects remain unquantified.

Existing direct replacement rules, default targets and all earlier approval fingerprints remain unchanged. No new helper, recipe, omitted exchange, runtime Python module, alternative UVEK sector engine or validation bypass. New exact-profile permissions do not approve processing of another metal or substitute virgin bulk-metal production.

The source aluminium processing-loss allowance separates cast and wrought alloy supply; native complete processing instead uses its aluminium production mix at the same combined loss-metal kg. Preserve the combined service basis without claiming the same cast/wrought alloy split, scrap content, forming history or allocation. No density, purity, alloy-content or yield correction is invented.

The source and target carry European regional labels, but matching labels do not prove the same company sample, power/heat, production portfolio, product form, delivery or vintage. Preserve the native European complete service with those limitations.
